description: Alma brings your nutrition context into ChatGPT. Connect your Alma account to ask about logged meals, nutrient gaps, Alma Score trends, goals, health metrics, workouts, weight changes, pantry, and grocery list. Get personalized guidance from your actual food history, spot patterns faster, and make better nutrition decisions without re-explaining your diet every time. When you explicitly confirm the details, Alma can also add a meal to your log. Alma supports general wellness and nutrition tracking, not medical advice.
